output.answer_markdown: The material does not give the percentage asked for. It has no computed figures for Ulta Beauty's total fiscal 2023 repurchase spend or its Q4 repurchase spend. The passages show that 352,005 shares were repurchased in the 14 weeks ended February 3, 2024 [1], which is a share count, not a dollar amount. They also show that $99.9 million remained available under the 2022 program as of February 3, 2024 [2]. Neither figure is enough to work out the Q4 share of full-year spend.
